text_block_list.text:
Toward the next dream— To get a look at 
the breathtaking view she aimed for, she 
decided to observe the Japan Cup. And 
there—

text_block_list.name: At the Crest
text_block_list.text: See ya ahead~! I'll be taking the lead!

At the Crest, who debuted in the same race 
as Buena Vista, takes the lead, setting a 
fast pace for the race.

"With a field packed with GⅠ-caliber 
Umamusume and rising stars like her rival 
Red Desire sprinting with all their might, 
breaking away from the pack was—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Vodka takes the lead! Vodka takes the 
lead!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Vodka-chan...!

Chasing after Vodka as she dashes toward 
the finish line, her rival surges forward 
with ferocious speed...! The one who 
seized victory in this breathtaking clash 
was—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh............ Hell yeahhh!! The 
strongest one here... is me!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The first Japanese Tiara Umamusume to 
conquer the Japan Cup! She truly was 
formidable! An incredible historic feat!!!
(Waaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible... Vodka...!" 
"Congraaaatulaaations!!" "—Whoaaaa, she 
just rewrote common sense...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible... Spe-chan...!" 
"Congraaaatulaaations!!" "—Whoaaaa, she 
beat the world...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list:
They're not identical, but... they really 
overlapped.

It's not exactly the same, but... it 
overlapped, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...This is what we were aiming for... 
What we have to aim for."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I dreamed... of the colors of that 
breathtaking viewâ

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
3rd place... How frustrating. Even so, 
but, still...—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san!! Ah, what a truly marvelous 
person she is...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If I lost to you, then I... ..."that 
place" has slipped further away, and 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—It felt as if you were holding me back... 
Please forgive my heart for racing so...!

Having watched the Japan Cup... Buena 
Vista's eyes sparkled with determination.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san and Vodka-chan. The breathtaking 
sights they both showed us are completely 
different, and yet... so similar.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san was victorious as the 
representative of Japan. Vodka-chan made 
history as the first ever...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. The breathtaking view we seek is... 
after all, right here."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"What we're aiming for is a breathtaking 
view that reaches everyone. In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Showing everyone the kind of victory 
they've all been waiting for, dreaming 
of... leads to that breathtaking view. 
—Just like today.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I want to live up to the feelings 
everyone sent me at the Shuka Sho... No, I 
want to see a view here that surpasses 
even that."
choice_data_list:
Our long-term goal is... next year's Japan 
Cup

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"That will surely be... the final 
destination of the dream that began on 
that day."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Together, the two of us will 
definitely... reach it!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Oh. Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that you are also here to 
watch the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Yes, so does that mean you too, 
Journey-san...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I watched it. After all, it was the 
grand stage for Vodka, the star of our 
class.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Waah~ So that's why you're cheering them 
on? Classmates have such a wonderful bond♪

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank you very much. She truly was 
wonderful, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Becoming the queen of the Junior Class, 
fulfilling the dream every racing official 
yearns for... Today, another chapter of 
history was written.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's an unrestricted performance that 
transcends any single track. Surely... 
you'll do the same.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...! I'm honored, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san is so kind... She's always 
looking out for me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. She's simply someone who makes 
you want to look out for her, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
By the way... I heard you're running in 
the "Arima Kinen." Actually, so am I.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Wah! So that's how it was...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To share even a fraction of your 
brilliance as you surge toward the center 
of this era... I shall do everything 
within my power.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm so thrilled to be able to race against 
you, Journey-san! I'll do my very best 
too!

Aiming for the breathtaking scenery of our 
dreams... With a fresh mindset, let's 
first repay the fans at the Arima Kinen.
